subject: Logic
title: Bandwagon Pressure
description: A short lesson to help you apply Bandwagon Pressure.

hook.text: "Everyone's switching to this app—don't get left behind!" FOMO dressed as an argument.

buildup.text: Bandwagon pressure combines popularity with urgency to push you into agreement without thinking.

discovery.text: It exploits social proof: if others are doing it, our brains assume it must be safe or smart.

twist.text: Tulip mania, dot-com stocks, viral hoaxes—crowds rush in together, and crash together.

climax.text: Before joining the crowd, ask: what's the evidence beyond popularity? Would I choose this alone?

quiz.question: What psychological effect does bandwagon pressure exploit?
